d:
In Jharkhand’s Ramgarh Thousands of women come together with hopes, determination and dreams of a better future. For many, the journey is about more than an opportunity, it is about independence, dignity and proving themselves against the odds.
With around 20,000 candidates competing for just 284 posts, the odds are steep. But for these women, every lap carries a dream much bigger than a government job.
The Indian Express' Shubham Tigga spends a day at the stadium, documenting their determination, struggles and aspirations.
